title: frontier install lock
description: The installation's pinned record of which distribution package it runs (spec #92, ticket #94). The file lives at <code>/.frontier/dist.lock.json. Package installs record the artifact digest, source URL, compatibility requirements and manifest digest; source installs use distribution 'source' and never pretend to have package digests (ticket #97). Extra fields are allowed so later tickets can extend the record without rewriting this schema.

distribution.description: How frontier was installed. Ticket #94 writes 'package'; #97 adds the source path.

version.description: Version recorded by the package manifest.

channel.description: Release channel recorded by the digest and package manifest.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded zip artifact before extraction; empty only for a source installation.

source_url.description: Canonical file:// URL (or future release URL) the artifact was installed from.

installed_at.description: ISO-8601 local time when this lock was written; preserved on an idempotent reinstall.

requires.description: Compatibility facts copied verbatim from the package manifest's compat object.

skill_digest.description: Reserved for #97's skill pointer digest; empty for a #94 package install.

package_file_count.description: Number of files listed by the package manifest (manifest.json itself is not counted).

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the extracted manifest.json bytes; empty only for a source installation.
